_comment: Prototype: how a golfer, not a coach, would say each condition and each theme member. Keyed by condition id, or by measure id + the raw direction the theme pushes it ('high'/'low'). The app version would carry these in the pack.

conditions.early_extension: you stand up through the ball
conditions.pelvis_thrust_backswing: your hips move toward the ball going back
conditions.reverse_spine_p4: you lean toward the target at the top
conditions.trail_knee_straighten: your trail leg straightens going back
conditions.over_the_top: your hands come over the top on the way down
conditions.hips_closed_at_impact: your hips haven't turned enough by impact
conditions.sway: your hips sway away from the target going back
conditions.slide: your hips slide toward the target
conditions.chicken_wing: your lead arm folds after impact
conditions.deceleration: the club slows down before impact
conditions.ball_too_close: you stand too close to the ball
conditions.ball_too_far: you stand too far from the ball
conditions.ball_back: the ball is too far back in your stance
conditions.ball_forward: the ball is too far forward in your stance
conditions.lead_knee_drifts_in_at_top: your lead knee works in going back
conditions.lie_flat_at_impact: the club's toe is up at impact
conditions.lie_steep_at_impact: the club's heel is up at impact
conditions.flying_elbow: your trail elbow flies out at the top
conditions.coming_out_of_it: you come up out of the shot
conditions.head_rise_backswing: your head comes up going back

measures.m_pelvisSwayDown:high: your hips slide toward the target
measures.m_pelvisSwayImpact:high: your hips slide toward the target
measures.m_pelvisSwayBack:high: your hips drift toward the target going back
measures.m_leadKneeDriftImpact:low: your lead knee goes with them
measures.m_leadArmToTorso:high: your lead arm folds after impact
measures.m_thoraxRotFinish:high: you turn your chest further into the finish
measures.m_comOverLeadFootFinish:low: you finish more over your lead side
measures.m_headLiftBack:high: your head comes up going back
measures.m_spineBendAtAddress:high: you bend over more at address
measures.m_pelvisRotP4:high: your hips turn further going back
measures.m_pelvisThrustBack:high: your hips move toward the ball
measures.m_pelvisRotP7:low: your hips are less turned at impact
measures.m_pelvisThrustDown:high: you stand up through the ball
measures.m_spineBendLossDown:low: you stand up through the ball
